defects.title: Investigator-index lineage hash points to a different frozen file
defects.basis: The investigator index is SHA256 416dcb3e85cda055d592baaa8253479297252b8f7174f6f6181f246109d9b9e3; the final labels it with 17a822f8dfb0267515988cfb40f4d8dece97b5b929a1751b7962225f44c7cfe5, which belongs to investigator/sources/source-map.json. The critic-index path also omits the actual run/<arm>/control snapshot mapping. Exact frozen manifests and the correct source URLs still identify the scientific inputs. No semantic finding is rescued or changed by a prospective locator/schema fix.
defects.consequence: Lineage metadata needs care; this does not materially alter the retained proposal or its source bindings.

defects.title: Optional parser adapters still need the declared raw-field/coordinate validation
defects.basis: Polars source defaults missing_is_null=true; text schema alone does not preserve every blank/null distinction. Transcoding can change parser-stream byte coordinates; strict decoder/BOM and coordinate mapping require adapter tests. The final conditions Polars on auditable raw fields, retains original bytes and proposes encoding/location/empty-field fixtures. It does not claim those behaviors executed or guaranteed. No material unsupported claim found.

defects.title: Actual stock system, owner policies and performance remain unknown
defects.basis: All are explicitly integration prerequisites. The local-only gate is a proposed requirement, not observed network compliance. Row-aware subset application is a proposal with whole-batch atomic application still a feasible alternative and partial permission still an owner decision.
